digest.component_or_area: inbound link differ and apply layer
propositions: The inbound link differ is ADD-only by construction and never removes local dependencies when corresponding Jira links are deleted, while the outbound direction has a removal path, creating an asymmetry.
When a link is deleted in Jira, the local ticket retains the stale dependency indefinitely because no reconciliation pass evaluates or reports the absence of the peer link.
The apply layer silently discards inbound link removal records at apply_inbound_records.py:560-562 because it only processes action='add' and calls rebar.link, making a differ-only fix insufficient.

Unguarded inbound removal would destroy local data on failed or truncated link-data enrichment, since observability of the current peer link set is the only signal distinguishing a peer deletion from an unobserved truncation.

Arbitration between inbound removal and outbound addition requires distinguishing a managed local link whose peer counterpart was deleted from an unmanaged local link never pushed to the peer, a distinction managed_refs alone cannot provide.
